propositions: Two regexes and one scope extractor key on '## Success Criteria' heading, making it load-bearing and blocking store migration verification.
The epic branch of _clarity_score in gates.py and its parallel copy in det_floor.py must be repointed from '^##\s+Success Criteria' to '^##\s+Acceptance Criteria' to unify criteria vocabulary.
_SCOPE_HEADINGS in assemble.py lists both 'success criteria' and 'acceptance criteria'; the success criteria entry must be dropped.
Seven test fixture files must have '## Success Criteria' blocks either removed (if dual-heading) or renamed to '## Acceptance Criteria' with bullets converted to checkboxes (if sole criteria block).
The clarity score bonus (+2) must be repointed rather than dropped to avoid regression across 108 migrated tickets and maintain epic fixture at score 6.
A new contract test must demonstrate an epic with '## Acceptance Criteria' and '## Context' passes both clarity-check and check-ac, with an assertion that _clarity_score(fixture, 'epic') == 6.
